placeholders.meaning: where the cursor lands after inserting
a link to today's daily page, such as [[2026-10-30]]
a link to another day: tomorrow, yesterday, +3, -1, monday, or 2026-11-02
the day's name, such as Friday
the title of the page you insert into
a fuzzy picker of names used before in blocks with that tag, newest first, or a new name
asks you while inserting; the same question is asked once and its answer reused

rules: Each top-level block on this page that has indented blocks under it is a template. Its text is the name; the indented blocks are what gets inserted.
Type jj at the start of an empty block anywhere, keep typing to narrow the list, and press Enter. In Vim, be in Insert mode first.
Live lists such as {{tasks: next}} and {{query: #idea}}, embeds, tags and links are copied as written, so they work on the page you insert into. Use here in a task list for that page.
Insertion is one undo step. A top-level block without indented blocks is a note, not a template, so you can leave headings or reminders here.

examples.name: Meeting
examples.use: Any meeting: pick a past one by name, or create a new one.

examples.name: One-on-one
examples.use: A recurring conversation; shows what is open with the person.
examples.definition:
- One-on-one
  - 1:1 with [[{ask: With whom?}]] #meeting
    - Their topics
      - {cursor}
    - My topics
    - Open between us
      - {{tasks: [[{ask: With whom?}]] open}}

examples.name: Project
examples.use: Insert on a project's own page; the tag puts it in Tasks > Projects.

examples.name: Person
examples.use: Insert on a person's page; tasks that link them gather here.
